entities.summary: Brian Theodore Tyler is an American composer, conductor, arranger and multi-instrumentalist best known for his film, television, and video game scores. In his 26-year career, Tyler has scored seven installments of the Fast & Furious franchise, Aliens vs. Predator: Requiem, the fourth and fifth films of the Rambo franchise, Eagle Eye, the fourth and fifth films of the Final Destination franchise, the first three films of The Expendables franchise, the Marvel Cinematic Universe films Iron Man 3, Thor: The Dark World, and Avengers: Age of Ultron alongside Danny Elfman, the Now You See Me franchise, Crazy Rich Asians, the fifth and sixth films of the Scream franchise, The Super Mario Bros.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Brian Tyler's film scores have had a significant impact on popular culture, with his work in franchises such as Fast & Furious and Marvel Cinematic Universe contributing to the success of these films. His collaborations with other notable composers like Danny Elfman have also helped shape the soundtracks of major blockbusters.
